mapper.sql: WITH signals AS ( SELECT ub.block_id, CASE WHEN ub.source = 'FREE' AND ub.acquired_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 0.3 ELSE 1.0 END AS w FROM user_block ub JOIN users u ON u.id = ub.user_id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.source <> 'CREATOR' UNION ALL SELECT pb.block_id, 2.0 FROM playlist p JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.playlist_id = p.id JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id, pb.block_id UNION ALL SELECT pb.block_id, LEAST(x.plays, 5) * 0.5 + LEAST(x.listens, 3) * 1.5 FROM ( SELECT playlist_id, SUM(plays) AS plays, SUM(listens) AS listens FROM ( SELECT target_id AS playlist_id, COUNT(*) AS plays, 0 AS listens FROM play_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = 'PLAYLIST' AND played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY target_id UNION ALL SELECT playlist_id, 0, COUNT(*) FROM listen_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND listened_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY playlist_id ) t GROUP BY playlist_id ) x JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.playlist_id = x.playlist_id JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id GROUP BY x.playlist_id, pb.block_id, x.plays, x.listens UNION ALL SELECT target_id, LEAST(COUNT(*), 3) * 0.3 FROM play_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND target_type = 'BLOCK' AND played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY target_id ), taste AS ( SELECT b.category_id, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) AS group_id, SUM(s.w) AS w FROM signals s JOIN block b ON b.id = s.block_id JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id GROUP BY b.category_id, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) ), cat_w AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(w) AS w FROM taste GROUP BY category_id), grp_w AS (SELECT group_id, SUM(w) AS w FROM taste GROUP BY group_id)
mapper.select: SELECT g.code, g.name, g.name_en, gw.w AS weight FROM grp_w gw JOIN sound_category g ON g.id = gw.group_id ORDER BY gw.w DESC, g.sort_order LIMIT #{limit}

, recent AS ( SELECT target_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM play_log WHERE target_type = 'BLOCK' AND played_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY target_id ) SELECT b.id, b.category_id AS group_key, COALESCE(cw.w, 0) * 1.5 + COALESCE(gw.w, 0) + LN(1 + COALESCE(r.n, 0) + COALESCE(b.play_count, 0) * 0.1) * 0.5 AS score FROM block b JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN cat_w cw ON cw.category_id = b.category_id LEFT JOIN grp_w gw ON gw.group_id = COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) LEFT JOIN recent r ON r.target_id = b.id WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.status = 'APPROVED' AND b.is_listed = true AND b.uploader_id <> #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.block_id = b.id) AND (cw.w IS NOT NULL OR gw.w IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY score DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

, combo AS ( SELECT p.id AS playlist_id, b.category_id, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) AS group_id FROM playlist p JOIN playlist_layer l ON l.playlist_id = p.id JOIN playlist_block pb ON pb.layer_id = l.id JOIN block b ON b.id = pb.block_id JOIN sound_category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE p.is_public = true AND p.is_hidden = false AND p.user_id <> #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM playlist mine WHERE mine.user_id = #{userId} AND mine.source_playlist_id = p.id) GROUP BY p.id, b.id, b.category_id, COALESCE(c.parent_id, c.id) ) SELECT x.playlist_id AS id, 0 AS group_key, SUM(COALESCE(cw.w, 0) * 1.5 + COALESCE(gw.w, 0)) / SQRT(COUNT(*)) + LN(1 + MAX(p.play_count)) * 0.3 AS score FROM combo x JOIN playlist p ON p.id = x.playlist_id LEFT JOIN cat_w cw ON cw.category_id = x.category_id LEFT JOIN grp_w gw ON gw.group_id = x.group_id GROUP BY x.playlist_id HAVING SUM(COALESCE(cw.w, 0) + COALESCE(gw.w, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY score DESC, x.playlist_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
